note: Named subsets of research/access/tasks.v1.json, kept apart from it so the task file's SHA-256 (recorded by every run) does not change. A subset lists task ids in tasks.v1.json order; a script reads the list from here instead of copying it. run-set.mjs selects them with --set all --only <ids> (the default --set frozen leaves out the blind tasks).
